routes.why: The landing page — the first thing anyone sees, and the only route a member reaches before connecting.
The home screen. The busiest member surface and the one most likely to regress as sections are added.
The wallet page hosts Transfer, Trade, Earn, Collect, Protect and Recovery behind tabs; a regression in its shell affects all of them.
The mini-app catalogue (a WalletPage tab, not its own route — /apps/<slug> is the workspace). The door to third-party packages, and image-heavy.
The Control Room. Renders the denied/unverified screens for non-operators, which is what an unauthenticated audit measures.
A public legal document: mostly text, so it is the control against which the app routes' costs can be read.
